韧性：断网、本地整理与并回 — recollect: Reliability: offline, local distillation and merge-back — recollect
连续一天连不上中心，本地节点就在暂存的数据上，一小批一小批地自己整理；满五天还没: One full day without reaching the hub, and the local node keeps distilling on the staged data, in small batches. Five days without recovery, and it acts as its own hub. When the hub comes back, the two sides merge in a fixed order: push → send back → confirm → pull snapshot, with no step skipped. Only when the last step succeeds and the local copy is still there does the staging get deleted.
断一天 / 断五天: One day down / five days down
断开中心，然后推进时间。状态名、暂存行数和自备份计数都按真实状态机走； 数值仅作: Cut the hub off, then advance time. State names, staging row counts and self-backup counts follow the real state machine; the numbers are illustrative and are not live readings.
第一步：先断开和中心的连接: Step one: cut the hub connection first
正常同步；失败的同步不进暂存。: In sync; failed syncs do not enter staging.
在本地暂存上小批小批地整理；只读副本一个字节不动。: Distils in small batches on the local staging area; the read-only copy is not touched byte for byte.
自备份成功后才进下一态；没确认的备份永远不删。: The next state comes only after a self-backup succeeds; unconfirmed backups are never deleted.
自己当中心；等确认并回之后，才允许清理旧备份。: Acts as its own hub; old backups may only be cleaned up after the merge back is confirmed.
四步全部走完，暂存才允许删。: Staging may only be deleted after all four steps finish.
并回去只有一种顺序: Merging back has one order only
先把本机新写的行推上去（push），再把离线期间攒的行送回去（rows），中心确: Push rows written locally (push), then send back the rows accumulated while offline (rows), and pull a new snapshot (pull) only after the hub confirms. If a step fails, the next one does not run and the local copy is not deleted; the next round sends the same batch again, the hub recognises it and does not write duplicates. Session reads work the same way: when the hub is unreachable, fall back to the local copy and mark the receipt
，不把本机结果冒充中心结果。: , never passing local results off as the hub's.
把本机新写的内容推给中心；失败就先停下。: Push what was written locally to the hub; stop on failure.
把离线期间攒的行送回去；中心答 200（成功）才进下一步。: Send back the rows accumulated offline; the next step runs only after the hub answers 200.
同一批送两次也只算一次，不会写重。: The same batch sent twice counts once; nothing is written twice.
拉回新快照；成功了、本地那份还在，才删暂存。: Pull the new snapshot; staging is deleted only if that succeeds and the local copy is still there.
不是断网。401/403 是没资格或被拒，409 是两边版本对不上；当成断网会误: Not the same as being offline. 401/403 means no permission or a rejection, 409 means the two versions disagree; treating them as offline triggers local distillation by mistake.
两个关口都按「连续连不上」累计，不是数失败了几次。: Both gates count consecutive unreachability, not the number of failed attempts.
断网期间只读副本不动；本地整理只写 pending.db 和 dr/。: While offline the read-only copy stays untouched; local distillation writes only to pending.db and dr/.
备份只管一件事：追平: A backup does one thing: catch up
备份按复制序号一条条追。落后就追；缺条目就报「不可用 + 缺口」，不拿旧内容冒充: A backup catches up entry by entry along the replication sequence. Behind, it catches up; missing entries, it reports "unavailable + gap" rather than passing off stale content. Only after catching up and passing verification may it take over.
hub backup · 读数口径: hub backup · how to read the numbers
三件一起写，保留最近 7 组；清单带版本和进度: All three written together, keeping the last 7 sets; the manifest carries version and progress
只做检查；恢复时把抽取进度退回清单上的位置: checks only; on restore, extraction progress is rolled back to the position in the manifest
脱离中心（断满五天）之后才启动；当前副本 + 暂存 + 原始对话 + 状态: Starts only after detaching from the hub (five days down); current copy + staging + raw transcript + state
并回原中心、确认之后，才允许清理: Cleaned up only after merging back into the original hub and confirming
面向 agent 的通用长期记忆服务。原始记录是事实源，记忆是索引。: A general long-term memory service for agents. Raw records are the source of truth; memory is the index.

断一天、断五天两道关，离线也能继续整理，网络恢复后按固定顺序并回；以及备份接班与: Two gates, one day down and five days down: keep distilling offline and merge back in a fixed order when the network returns; plus backup takeover and isolation from the old hub.
断一天/断五天两道关，离线继续整理与固定顺序并回。: Two gates, one day down and five days down: offline distillation and an ordered merge back.
